source.rationale: Second true-negative variant: a function change that lives entirely under a top-level tests/ directory. Should be excluded by change_filter's test-path detection (Engineering Decision Log Entry 11: path-segment comparison, fixed specifically to catch a top-level tests/ folder, not just a nested one) before it's even considered for linking, regardless of whether any doc happens to mention the function name.

labels.notes_for_labeler: CONFIRMED (real run) at face value, same caveat as case 026: the empty stale_doc_section makes the Verifier trivially say not-stale, which doesn't actually test whether change_filter's test-path detection (Entry 11) would correctly exclude this tests/ file change before linking is even attempted. Needs a full main.py run against a real diff touching an actual tests/ path to be a meaningful regression check for Entry 11's original bug.
